51135759.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to HER2 extracellular domain (unknown origin) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: The binding affinity of lipid conjugate SA-5 to HER2 protein extracellular domain was examined by surface plasmon resonance analysis. HER2 protein was immobilized on a CM5 chip, and lipid conjugate SA-5 was used as analyte. Upon addition of SA-5, there was an increase in sensorgram response, suggesting that SA-5 binds to HER2 ECD (Fig. 4A). Addition of different concentrations of SA-5 showed concentration-dependent binding to HER2 -ECD. The kinetics of association and dissociation were calculated based on a 1:1 Langmuir interaction model and the Kd value was calculated by curve fitting. The Kd for SA-5: HER2 ECD was 1.16 μM. Similar experiments were conducted on a control peptide. The control peptide did not show any binding to HER2- ECD (Supporting Information). These results clearly indicate the specific binding of SA-5 to HER2 -ECD. A fluorescently labeled conjugate SA-5-6FAM also showed the binding ability to HER2 -ECD (Fig. 4B).
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. SPR analysis of binding of conjugates to HER2 ECD. A) Concentration-dependent binding of conjugate SA-5 to HER2 protein was seen. Experiments were repeated twice, and a representative sensorgram is shown here. B) SPR sensorgrams for the binding kinetics of SA-5-6FAM with HER2 protein extracellular domain. Concentration-dependent binding of conjugate SA-5-6FAM to HER2 protein was seen. Experiments were repeated twice, and a representative sensorgram is shown here.
original_paragraph.Figure 4A sensorgram data: Figure 4A shows sensorgrams for SA-5 at concentrations of 0.5 μM, 1 μM, 5 μM, 10 μM, 25 μM, 50 μM, and 100 μM. The x-axis represents Time (Sec) from 0 to 600, and the y-axis represents Response units (RU) from 0 to 160. The curves show increasing response with higher concentrations, with the 100 μM curve reaching approximately 140 RU.
original_paragraph.Figure 4B sensorgram data: Figure 4B shows sensorgrams for SA-5-6FAM at concentrations of 0 μM, 5 μM, 10 μM, 25 μM, 50 μM, and 100 μM. The x-axis represents Time (Sec) from 0 to 600, and the y-axis represents Response units (RU) from 0 to 120. The curves show increasing response with higher concentrations, with the 100 μM curve reaching approximately 110 RU.

analyte.concentration_range: 0.5 μM - 100 μM (for SA-5); 0 μM - 100 μM (for SA-5-6FAM)
